verdict.rationale: Sentry's official getsentry/sentry-api-schema GitHub repository publishes a downloadable, dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document covering the full public /api/0/ surface. The probe's 404s on conventional docs.sentry.io paths only show the spec is hosted on GitHub rather than the docs site; they do not contradict the capability. missing for 10: discoverability at standard docs/well-known OpenAPI paths, independent hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API" (info title "API Reference", version v0), covering the full /api/0/ surface.
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
